title: cardamine hirsuta var. pensylvanica
intro: Cardamine hirsuta var. pensylvanica, commonly known as Pennsylvania bittercress, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pennsylvania bittercress include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate cold symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
